  - Create KMS key and provide ARN (if using customer-managed KMS) — owner: Security/Cloud team — due 2026-11-16

Next steps (ask):

2) Confirm whether Acme will provide a KMS key for the POC or if you prefer Redwood-managed encryption.

Samantha, John —

Thanks — answers inline below and attached an updated MAP (redwood-map-draft-v1.1.pdf) with the dates adjusted for the targets we discussed:

- Redwood egress IPs: 35.202.14.0/24, 34.120.200.0/24 (these are the ranges we will use for the POC egress). Please add these to your allowlist.
- Mutual TLS: not required for the initial POC. We use TLS for all connections; mTLS can be added later if you prefer.
- VPC peering: Redwood will provide the peer VPC ID and suggested route table entries by EOD 2026-11-12. Nikhil will be the technical contact for the peering exchange.
- SSO/SAML: Redwood supports SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated). We'll send SP metadata and a test account by EOD 2026-11-12.
- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS. For the POC, if you provide a temporary KMS key ARN we can demonstrate integration; otherwise Redwood-managed encryption is fine for initial testing.

Revised milestone schedule (from MAP v1.1):
- 2026-11-12: Redwood provides peering config, SAML SP metadata, and egress IP confirmation (Redwood)
- 2026-11-16: Acme completes peering, routing, and allowlist (Acme)
- 2026-11-18: Smoke test and validation (joint) — target POC ready date

Next actions:
- John: confirm peering ETA and any required contact details for your network team (phone/email).
- Priya (security): if you can share whether you'll supply a KMS ARN for POC or prefer Redwood-managed.
